steps.heading: sort_values vs. sort_index
steps.body: sort_values() orders rows by the data in one or more columns. sort_index() orders rows by their index labels instead, useful for restoring the original order after a filter or a previous sort.

steps.heading: Highest revenue first
steps.caption: ascending=False reverses the default low-to-high order.

steps.heading: Multiple keys, multiple directions
steps.body: Passing a list of columns sorts by the first, using the rest only to break ties. Passing a matching list to ascending= lets each key have its own direction.
